title: Obvara Firing with Rachel Levine
source_quote: Obvara Firing with Rachel Levine Fall dates now online! ... Available October 4 & November 1, 11AM - 3PM.
evidence_sentence: The homepage lists Obvara firing as a Baltic twist on raku, with workshop dates October 4 and November 1.
evidence_quote: Join us to learn a Baltic twist on raku! In this 4-hour workshop with DCC instructor Rachel Levine, students will learn the magic of Obvara firing.
summary: A 4-hour Obvara firing workshop with instructor Rachel Levine on October 4 or November 1, 11 AM–3 PM. Students learn to heat pottery to red-hot, pull it from the kiln, and dip it in fermented flour for black, white, and tan surface effects.
